device.description: 8-channel 10-bit 50-200 kSPS SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial interface
device.note: adc108s022.pdf (SNAS338F) p.1 connection diagram, p.2 pin descriptions, p.3 operating ratings, p.4 output coding, p.5-6 timing specifications and Figures 2-3 (operational and serial timing), p.15 serial interface and control register (Tables 1-3)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: Control Register (Table 1): bits 7-6 and 2-0 DONTC, ADD2-ADD0 select the channel of the next conversion; IN0 is the default (Table 3), first conversion after power-up is IN0

commands.name: CONTROL
commands.note: DIN loaded on the first 8 SCLK rising edges after CS falls; ADD selects the input of the next conversion

pages: p.1 (connection diagram), p.2 (pin descriptions), p.3 (operating ratings: VA 2.7-5.25 V, VD 2.7 V to VA, digital inputs 0 V to VA), p.4 (straight binary), p.5-6 (tEN 30 ns, tDACC 27 ns, tDIS 20 ns max; Figures 2-3: 4 leading zeros, DB9-DB0, 2 trailing zeros; DIN DONTC DONTC ADD2 ADD1 ADD0 DONTC DONTC DONTC), p.15 (serial interface, Tables 1-3)
notModeled: analog inputs; VA is also the reference (the result is always the 0 V code 0x000)
conversion clocked by SCLK (3 track + 13 hold cycles) is not timed: the result is the 0 V code at once
continuous conversion: frames of N*16 SCLKs with CS held low convert again every 16 clocks (the model handles one 16-bit frame per CS low; later frames shift the idle level)
power-down while CS is high (no state is lost; supply current only)
SCLK frequency (0.8-3.2 MHz specified, 50 kHz-16 MHz operating) and throughput limits
digital inputs are specified 0 V to VA (VA may exceed VD); vcc is the VD range 2.7-5.25 V
variants: ADC108S052, ADC108S102: same pinout, frame and control register; they differ only in SCLK range and throughput (separate datasheets)
